i.norm: Verifies that toString() produces a correctly formatted frequency table when a single integer value is added using a custom comparator. A mocked comparator that always returns 0 (equal) is used to control ordering. After adding the value 46 once, the table should show 100% frequency and 100% cumulative percentage for that single entry.
Create a mock comparator that always considers integers as equal (returns 0)
Build a Frequency table using the custom comparator
The table should contain one row for value 46 with count=1, 100% frequency, 100% cumulative
